text:
incident-bot: [PAGER] SLA breach detected for tenant 'ClearWave' on /v1/generate - error rate > 5% over 3m, paging oncall @alice.k :rotating_light:

alice.k: on it. grabbing logs and checking recent deploys. any recent config changes for tenant routing?

marco.t: no deploys in last 12h. I saw a couple of 503s from the inference pool around 02:12 UTC earlier. could be a noisy health-check hitting that tenant?

priya.s: looking at metrics now — error spikes correlate with long tail latency from a dedicated pod behind autoscaler. starts at 02:10, ~40% of requests for ClearWave timed out between 1-2s threshold.

dana_ops: customer reported increased latency in their dashboard about the same time. they said sometimes requests fail with "timeout while waiting for model".

alice.k: ok. for immediate mitigation can we silence pagers for this tenant-specific check while we triage? it's noisy since it's hitting only tenant X and not impacting global capacity.

marco.t: +1 to mute paging but keep the alert in dashboards. We should avoid completely hiding the signal. I'll create a temporary suppression rule scoped to tenant=ClearWave for 30m.

priya.s: filed suppression: incident-bot, suppress alert id tenant_sla_clearwave_503 for 30m (reason: isolated tenant timeout, active triage).

incident-bot: suppression created by marco.t: tenant_sla_clearwave_503 - expires in 30m.

alice.k: thanks. next step: root cause — looks like that pod's KV cache grew and GC caused janky latency. Marco can you confirm mem/GC on that host?

marco.t: yep. host gw-12 shows memory spikes and frequent GC logs. stack shows heavy prefix-KV growth for this tenant (large multi-turn chats). The runtime didn't evict prefixes fast enough.

priya.s: we can apply an emergency config to reduce per-tenant KV retention to 50% for the affected pool. That should drop memory pressure and reduce timeouts. Impact: slightly more cache misses for ClearWave (potentially higher cost), but reduces 503s.

alice.k: do it. while that's rolling, I'll message customer success to set expectations.

marco.t: pushed kv_retention_percent=50 to pool clearwave-pool (rolling restart of 2 nodes). watch logs and metrics.

oncall-bot: deploy job started by marco.t (job id dj-8841). ETA ~ 5m.

priya.s: seeing initial drop in p95 latency from 1.8s to 900ms on pool gw-12 after restart of node-1. error rate trending down.

alice.k: nice. keep suppression until we confirm stability. Also we should avoid paging for a single-tenant transient spike — proposal: change alert policy to require either (a) tenant error rate > 5% for 15m OR (b) global error rate > 2% for 3m to trigger paging. That prevents noisy tenant checks from waking oncall for short transient tenant-specific issues.

marco.t: agree. I'll draft the new policy and add a secondary condition that a tenant-level alert only pages if >= 3 distinct hosts show errors (helps with single-host noise).

priya.s: add an automated dashboard panel that surfaces "tenant impact breadth" (number of hosts with >1% errors) and link it in the alert runbook. Also add a quick action to mute paging scoped to tenant for 15/30/60m from the alert UI.

alice.k: action items: (1) Marco update alert policy + add host-count condition, (2) Priya create dashboard panel and quick mute button, (3) Dana follow up with CS and log the customer impact note. We'll reconvene after suppression expires.

marco.t: opened PR to monitoring: PR#512 - tenant paging refinement + host-count gate. WIP tests in staging.

priya.s: new dashboard panel created in staging -> "Tenant Impact Breadth". Created ticket MON-778 to add quick mute UI and link it in runbook.

dana_ops: CS notified ClearWave, they acknowledged and appreciate the heads-up. logged customer note CW-INC-2026-03-15.

alice.k: final check — error rate back to baseline, suppression will expire in 18m, but I plan to leave it off until we've promoted the new policy. Great coordination, thanks everyone.

incident-bot: suppression for tenant_sla_clearwave_503 expires at 1785023520 unless extended.

alice.k: postmortem will be short: root cause KV retention and single-host GC causing tenant-specific timeouts; mitigations: reduce retention, refine paging policy, add dashboard + mute UI, retrospective scheduled tomorrow 15:00 UTC. I'll create the postmortem doc and link MON-778 and PR#512.

marco.t: noted. adding extra telemetry for KV growth per tenant to MON-779.

priya.s: leaving a snippet for runbook quick-mute command if needed:

```
# mute oncall for tenant
curl -X POST "https://monitoring.internal/alerts/suppress" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"alert_id":"tenant_sla_clearwave_503","scope":{"tenant":"ClearWave"},"duration_minutes":30}'
```

alice.k: thanks. closing the pager thread now since incident stabilized. will post postmortem link here when done. :white_check_mark:
